Maria / Tessa / team,

Thanks for the briefing. I ran the Novexa comments against our standard MSA and a few notes up front:

- Exhibit B: I’ve added a temporary capacity table (rows for Months 1-3 @ 250k tokens) and then the baseline. This keeps the uplift auditable while preserving the standard renewal mechanics.
- Billing proration: we’ll default to option (b) in Tessa's note (billing start 12/01 with a one-time credit if signature occurs after 12/01). This avoids mid-month bill fragmentation for both sides. If you need strict proration to signature, we can revise.
- Caching clause: we cannot accept broad language that implies full isolation of prefix caches across all customers (technical limitations). I propose language that prohibits intentional sharing of customer-specific KV prefixes and requires Redwood to apply best-effort separation and to provide logs on request for the pilot period. That gives Novexa evidence without committing to architectural changes.
- Term language: we can move to a 12-month fixed term but request Redwood retains right to convert to auto-renew with 60 days notice after the initial term; we can make this explicit in the orderform to keep the MSA stable.

Attached: Novexa_MSARedline_v1.docx (markup), Exhibit-B-draft.xlsx (clean). Please review and flag anything you need tightened.

Ben
